name: dig_while_using_place_while_digging
about: Sword-blocking then holding attack on the floor (1.7.10 digs and swings while blocking; 1.8.9 does nothing), and holding attack on the floor with stone in hand while pressing and holding use (1.7.10 places while digging; 1.8.9 ignores right clicks while hitting a block).

steps.note: hold attack on the floor while blocking
stone in hand: dig the floor, press use while digging
